'You may play Howl from Beyond from your banished zone. / The next attack action card you play this turn gains +1{p}.' + **Go again** / **Blood Debt**, Shadow Action (Monarch).

PRINTED KEYWORDS NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain and BloodDebt both appear in printed_keywords and fire from the card DB keywords field engine-side (go again pays +1 AP when this non-attack card layer resolves; blood debt is a start-of-end-phase lose-1-life trigger while face-up in the banished zone). Re-authoring either would be a defect (the 'keyword-reimplemented' finding class). Both are unconditional printed lines, so no SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword shape applies.

CLAUSE 1 - play-from-banished PERMISSION, not a cost: declarative STATIC PLAYABLE_FROM_BANISHED, shape copied from SHIPPED chn/rift_bind_blue.json (same wording). Engine-READ, never resolved: play._self_playable_from_banished (play.py:786-797) scans the card's declared static effect types while it sits in the banished zone, and the play-offering path consults it - so the permission cannot outlive or mis-time the card's presence.

CLAUSE 2 - pump: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK with a filter, shape copied from SHIPPED wtr/nimblism_yellow.json ('The next attack action card ... you play this turn gets +2{p}'), minus Nimblism's ATTACK_COST_LTE bound since Howl has none. ATTACK_TYPE_IN ['Action'] + ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN ['Attack'] together name exactly an attack ACTION card - the type test excludes weapon attacks (weapons carry types [Weapon]). Handler verified at effect_types.py:4592-4618: reads mod/amount/filter/scope; queues a one-shot entry on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods ('you play'), consumed by the first qualifying attack declared that turn; default scope TURN and end-of-turn expiry of unused entries (engine.py ~921) carry 'this turn'.

No gaps.
